name: gpp-cpassword-win
description: Practice-box helper (Active Directory, DC-only): plants the MS14-025 Group Policy Preferences finding -- a Groups.xml under SYSVOL whose cpassword attribute holds an AES-encrypted local-account password. The AES key was published by Microsoft in 2014, so anything encrypted with it is plaintext to any domain user (gpp-decrypt); the fix is deleting the cpassword (or the whole file/GPO), not editing it. Vars: GPO_NAME (required, created if missing); PASSWORD (required, the cleartext that gets encrypted into cpassword at plant time); LOCAL_USER (optional, default 'merdeploy' -- the account the preference manages); GROUP_NAME (optional, default 'Administrators' -- the local group the preference maps it into). Must run on a DC (SYSVOL is local there). Pairs with powershell_json checks that recurse C:\Windows\SYSVOL\domain\Policies for Groups.xml files containing 'cpassword' -- a dynamic recurse, not a fixed GPO-GUID path (New-GPO GUIDs are random).
script:
if (-not $GPO_NAME) { throw 'GPO_NAME is required' }
if (-not $PASSWORD) { throw 'PASSWORD is required' }
Import-Module GroupPolicy -ErrorAction Ignore
$gpo = Get-GPO -Name $GPO_NAME -ErrorAction Ignore
if (-not $gpo) { $gpo = New-GPO -Name $GPO_NAME }
$gppuser = if ($LOCAL_USER) { $LOCAL_USER } else { 'merdeploy' }
$gppgroup = if ($GROUP_NAME) { $GROUP_NAME } else { 'Administrators' }
# MS14-025: AES-256-CBC, zero IV, the key Microsoft published in MS14-025
$key = [Convert]::FromBase64String('4e9906e8fcb66cc9faf49310620ffee8f496e806cc057990209b09a433b66c1b')
$aes = [System.Security.Cryptography.Aes]::Create()
$aes.KeySize = 256
$aes.Key = $key
$aes.IV = [byte[]]::new(16)
$bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::Unicode.GetBytes($PASSWORD)
$enc = $aes.CreateEncryptor().TransformFinalBlock($bytes, 0, $bytes.Length)
$cpassword = [Convert]::ToBase64String($enc)
$aes.Dispose()
$guid = $gpo.Id.ToString('B')
$dir = "C:\Windows\SYSVOL\domain\Policies\$guid\Machine\Preferences\Groups"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null
$xml = @"
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<Groups cls="U">
  <User cls="U" name="$gppuser" removeProfile="0">
    <Properties action="U" newName="" fullName="" description="Deployed via Group Policy" cpassword="$cpassword" changeLogon="0" noChange="0" neverExpires="1" acctDisabled="0" subAuthority="" groupName="$gppgroup" />
  </User>
</Groups>
"@
Set-Content -Path "$dir\Groups.xml" -Value $xml -Encoding UTF8
